data.content_ref: inline:The isolated 14ab0ddd3b5e shares mechanism with SRC_004 in that both invoke a pricing model as the determinant of cost. However, they are inversely related: 14ab0ddd3b5e (following SRC_002) uses a uniform linear model yielding $6, while SRC_004 uses a nonlinear bulk-discount counterfactual yielding <$6. The shared mechanism is 'model-driven cost determination'; the divergence is the model choice. This is REFUTED IF either artifact does not actually commit to a specific pricing model (i.e., if it merely reports $6 without a model, there is no shared mechanism to compare).
